description: A standalone billboard showing a wire manager colour collection, for including in a patch you share or in a video.
notes: with no collection loaded the billboard follows the colours of an active WM-101, so load a collection or keep a WM-101 in the patch for it to have anything to show.
menu: Load collection — opens a file dialog for a saved wire manager collection to show on the billboard.
3D billboard — draws the cables with a rounded shading; switched off, they are drawn flat.
Lock colors — stops the billboard following an active WM-101, which is what to do before sharing a patch.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
